title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
abstract: arXiv:2610.18820v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the Scenario-Actor, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. translated_title: 让模型在生成前先“察言观色”
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通常依赖采样温度来调节输出的随机性程度。主流的温度选择方法通常采用固定的、启发式的全局设置，以及上下文或词元级别的校准，而不是对交际场景进行几何上可解释的表征。在本工作中，我们提出了一个简单且可解释的温度选择框架——Scenario-Actor（场景-行动者），它能够根据推断出的情境特征来调整解码策略。Scenario-Actor 从 Transformer 隐藏状态中提取与场景相关的结构，并通过场景嵌入——一种对交际环境进行结构化几何表征的形式——来确定温度。实证结果表明，在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，Scenario-Actor 在交互式社交场景中实现了出色的目标完成性能，在开放式指令遵循任务上取得了显著提升，并展现出具有竞争力的表现。
tldr: 提出 Scenario-Actor 框架，从 Transformer 隐藏状态中提取交际场景的结构化几何表征（场景嵌入），据此自适应地选择解码温度，从而在交互社交场景和开放式指令遵循任务上显著提升 LLM 的表现。
en_tdlr: Scenario-Actor is a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework that determines decoding temperature from structured geometric scenario embeddings extracted from Transformer hidden states, adapting generation to the communicative situation and achieving strong performance in interactive social scenarios and open-ended instruction following.
